card.name: The ending of "determinations" in lab tests
card.fires_on: The final piece "ations" completing the word "determinations" after a lab test name (serum, urinary, potassium level). It also fires weakly on the endings of a few other split words such as "vial" and "lobes".

modes.label: Lab determinations
modes.description: The ending of "determinations" after a named lab measurement.
modes.example: Patients should have serum potassium level determin<<ations>> at periodic intervals.

modes.label: Other split words
modes.description: The ending of an uncommon word split into pieces, such as vial or lobes.
